description: This PHP class EmployeeEventService provides methods for managing employee events within the OrangeHRM system. It includes functionalities such as creating, saving, and retrieving employee event records, with dependencies on DAOs and utility traits. The class is part of the plugin namespace for employee management features.

classes.name: EmployeeEventService
classes.description: Service class providing functionalities for managing employee events including creation, retrieval, and role management in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getEmployeeEventDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the EmployeeEventDao instance responsible for database operations related to employee events.

methods.name: setEmployeeEventDao
methods.description: Setter method to set the EmployeeEventDao instance, typically for dependency injection.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Saves a given EmployeeEvent entity using the DAO.

methods.name: saveEvent
methods.description: Creates and saves an EmployeeEvent with specified parameters such as employee number, event type, and notes, setting creator and timestamp.

methods.name: getEmployeeEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of EmployeeEvent objects based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Fetches the role of the current user, defaults to 'System' if no user is present.

methods.name: saveAddEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Convenience method to save an employee creation event.

methods.name: saveUpdateEmployeePersonalDetailsEvent
methods.description: Convenience method to save an event for updating personal details.

methods.name: saveUpdateJobDetailsEvent
methods.description: Convenience method to save an event for updating job details.
